test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following countries will host the 2024 South Asian Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2024 South Asian Games will be hosted by** Pakistan**.
 
• The games will be held in **Lahore, the capital of Punjab province**.
 
• The games were originally scheduled to be held in **March 2023**, but were later postponed to March 2024 by the **South Asia Olympic Council (SAOC) **members at the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) conference in** Phnom Penh, Cambodia**.
 
• Pakistan has hosted the South Asian Games twice before, in **1989 and 2004**.
 
• Both times, the games were held in **Islamabad**.
 
• The South Asian Games is a quadrennial multi-sport event that is held among **athletes from South Asia**.
 
• The governing body of these games is the SAOC, which is formed by 7 member countries:** Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka**.
 
• The 2024 South Asian Games will feature** 27 sports and 376 events**.
 
• The games are expected to attract over** 5,000 athletes from 7 member countries**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The South Asian Games is a multi-sport biennial event that is held among the South Asian athletes.
 
• South Asia Olympic Council (SAOC), founded in 1983, is the governing body of those sports.
 
• Seven members currently join SAG, namely Bangladesh, Nepal,Bhutan, India, the Maldives, Pakistan and Sri Lanka.
 
• The first event was held in Nepal on September 1984
